title: Reuse-metrics tracking (downloads/queries)
context: PLAN.md tracks reuse (external downloads/queries of exports) as a success metric, reported quarterly from M2 onward. A lightweight, privacy-respecting mechanism is needed to count downloads of the GEDCOM 7, GEDCOM X JSON, and JSON-LD exports without collecting visitor PII. The metrics are used to demonstrate real-world uptake to candidate stewards and in quarterly outcome reports.
objective: Define and implement a lightweight, privacy-respecting reuse-metrics approach for tracking export downloads and (if a query endpoint is added) query counts, without collecting visitor PII, and document the methodology and reporting cadence.
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics approach chosen and documented: collects download/query counts without collecting visitor IP addresses, user agents beyond aggregated counts, or other PII.
Metrics collected for each export format (GEDCOM 7, GEDCOM X JSON, JSON-LD) individually.
Metrics reporting cadence defined: quarterly report template committed to docs/metrics-template.md.
First metrics baseline recorded after M2 explorer launch (even if zero downloads).
Implementation committed (configuration or lightweight script) via PR with documentation in docs/metrics-methodology.md.
output: docs/metrics-methodology.md (methodology and privacy stance) and docs/metrics-template.md (quarterly report template), committed via PR.
